_comment: Creature Burn (2026-11-20, Stage 2 batch 1). Flame Javelin is {2/R}{2/R}{2/R} -- mana value 6, but
castable for {R}{R}{R} (the twobrid variant; on an all-Mountain board the MTG_TWOBRID_COLOUR_FOLD offers
only that one). Four Mountains, Javelin + Lightning Bolt in hand, opponent at 7: {R}{R}{R} Javelin (4) +
{R} Bolt (3) is exactly lethal this turn. A parse or payment that only knew the all-generic {6} side could
cast neither on four lands with the Bolt too, and the game would not end on turn 4.
